mapper.select: SELECT ID, ProductName, LinkName, workshop_name AS workshopName, WorkDate, GroupID, ClassID, UserID, CreateTime, shift_source AS shiftType, custom_shift_id AS customShiftId, custom_shift_period AS customShiftPeriod, custom_continuous_shift AS customContinuousShift, rest_shift_type AS restShiftType FROM tbplanlist WHERE WorkDate = (SELECT MAX(WorkDate) FROM tbplanlist) ORDER by ${sortField} ${sortOrder} LIMIT ${pageNum},${pageSize}
